numeric_changes.source_excerpt: 先看一组假设，不把它冒充任何公司的盈利预测：10万个付费用户，每人每月平均实际付款30美元，月收入为300万美元；月推理与托管成本120万美元，另有60万美元交付成本，包括支持、内容许可和支付费用，则毛利120万美元、毛利率40%。这还没有减研发、销售、管理、利息和税，不能叫净利润率。
numeric_changes.english_excerpt: Start with assumptions, not any company's earnings forecast: 100,000 paying users averaging USD 30 monthly generate USD 3 million revenue. Monthly inference/hosting costs USD 1.2 million, plus USD 600,000 delivery costs including support, content licenses and payment fees, leave USD 1.2 million gross profit and 40% gross margin. R&D, sales, administration, interest and tax are not deducted, so this is not net margin.

numeric_changes.source_excerpt: 若推理与托管单价降30%、总用量增20%，这项成本由120万美元变为100.8万美元；收入与其他交付成本暂时不变时，毛利变为139.2万美元、毛利率46.4%。因此上游API价格下降不必导致下游应用毛利下降。若竞争又迫使应用售价降20%，月收入变为240万美元，同样成本下毛利率则仅33.0%。最后结果取决于节约由用户、应用商还是模型商拿走。
numeric_changes.english_excerpt: If inference/hosting unit prices fall 30% and total usage rises 20%, that cost falls from USD 1.2 million to USD 1.008 million. With revenue and other delivery costs unchanged, gross profit becomes USD 1.392 million and gross margin 46.4%. Upstream API cuts therefore need not reduce application gross margins. If competition also cuts application selling prices 20%, monthly revenue falls to USD 2.4 million and the same costs leave only 33.0% gross margin. Outcomes depend on whether users, application vendors or model providers retain savings.

numeric_changes.english_excerpt: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory's June 2026 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report: 2025 Update gives a 2030 reference scenario of 649TWh annual consumption, approximately 11.8% of US electricity, and a combined uncertainty range of 521–843TWh, or 9.5%–15.3%. This forecasts multiple data-center types, not actual pure-AI consumption or contracted power demand. The reference case depends on equipment shipments, operations, cooling and other inputs; “2025” in the title does not mean the projected endpoint has already occurred. [LBNL official report page, June 2026](https://datacenters.lbl.gov/publications/united-states-data-center-energy-2025)
